name: 46034-visionprefill-10b-1gpu
model: stepfun-ai/Step3-VL-10B. Ungated, apache-2.0, ~20.4 GB of bf16 safetensors in 5 shards, and it carries remote code.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. `--distributed-executor-backend uni`: one process, no worker subprocess.
architecture: multimodal decoder: a Qwen3 text tower behind a PerceptionEncoder vision tower and a convolutional projector; it loads through remote code and the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=5 req/s, warmup 13%, no cooldown, bounded at 230 requests with a 300 s safety cap. 200 measured behind 30 warmups is 13%, about 46 s of wall clock.
workload: single-turn vision prefill: ONE 448x448 image plus a 128-token text prompt per request, 4 output tokens. Two guidellm datasets zipped row-wise, `synthetic_text` for the prompt and the output length and `synthetic_image` for the image, seeded per row so that no two requests send the same picture. The image geometry is pinned: this checkpoint's preprocessing is size-dependent, so another size is another workload and not a comparable one. The run is the declared one only if every request carries exactly one image (`input_metrics.image_pixels` == 200704), no request errors, and the achieved successful rate is the declared 5/s; the reported prompt_token_count runs well above the declared 128 because the image and the chat template expand it on the wire.
purpose: A single-image visual question service on one H100, answering 10-billion-parameter vision prompts with brief replies at five requests per second.
launch:
# vLLM engine arguments.

model: stepfun-ai/Step3-VL-10B

# REQUIRED: this checkpoint's config.json loads through remote code and cannot be read without it.
trust-remote-code: true

max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# One engine process, no worker subprocess.
distributed-executor-backend: uni
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Structured value: MUST stay on one line -- the engine reads line by line and skips indented
# ones, so re-flowing this drops the key and the engine starts without it at rc=0.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1, "video": 0}

dtype: bfloat16

# An override: prefix caching is on by default on this engine.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Structured value: MUST stay on one line, as with limit-mm-per-prompt above. Both of these keys
# are required rather than tuned -- left unset, the engine derives its own item cap and budget
# ladder for this checkpoint and the capture pools do not fit in 80 GB, so it fails at startup.
compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mm_encoder": true, "encoder_cudagraph_token_budgets": [169, 338, 676], "encoder_cudagraph_max_vision_items_per_batch": 4}
